candidate_2.project: Concreting of Barangay Cabasaran to Barangay Dao FMR, Gamay, Northern Samar

sources: FY2021 DBM Summary of Funds for Direct Release to Implementing Agencies

primary_procurement.result: No exact primary PhilGEPS procurement notice/award record located in the controlled web search.

contract.source: Northern Samar 2nd DEO report reproduced in Leyte-Samar Daily Express, 23 Nov 2021
contract.caveat: Useful evidence that the project was under contract, but not treated as a recovered primary contract record.

completion.caveat: Agency-reported completion is not independent physical verification.

candidate_2.chain_disposition: Budget identity + agency-origin contract/implementation/completion evidence established; primary procurement and project-specific financial execution not established.

temporal_lineage_observation_candidate_2.detail: The same Cabarasan–Dao corridor also appears in older DPWH records as a 2016 FMR project evaluated at a 9.173 million contract amount with CDU Construction. A separate 2024 listing identifies a Road Opening of Barangay Cabarasan–Dao Farm to Market Road Phase II. These are treated as separate interventions, not joined to the selected 2021 FMR absent project-level identity evidence.
temporal_lineage_observation_candidate_2.why_important: The ontology permits multiple interventions affecting the same physical road segment over time; route-name similarity alone is not sufficient identity proof.

final_result.candidate_2: PRIMARY_PROCUREMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED; CONTRACT/IMPLEMENTATION DOCUMENTED VIA AGENCY-ORIGIN SECONDARY EVIDENCE; OBLIGATION/PAYMENT UNRESOLVED
